description: Draws up to 6 moments of the video as it is saved (captions, graphics, overlays and all) and returns them as images. Look before you change a moment and again after. A first look at a version can take a few seconds. Cost: Free: no credits.

at.description: Up to 6 film seconds to draw.

base_version.description: A version_id to read; the live version when left out.

output_id.description: A Short, hook or shape of the video; the main video when left out.

size.description: The long side in pixels, 256 to 1280; 768 when left out.

name: get_screenshot

outputSchema.description: Clypmint get_screenshot result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Look at frames
